content_sections.heading: About DHS Ramanathapuram
content_sections.text: The District Health Society works under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu, and the notice is issued under the name of the State Health Society, Tamil Nadu, Department of Medical and Public Health. These Radiographers will work under the Joint Director - Health Services and the Joint Director - Medical Services (Tuberculosis). The recruitment is run by the District TB Centre on the Government Medical College Hospital campus in Ramanathapuram.

faq.question: Q1. How many Radiographer posts are vacant?
faq.answer: There are two (02) Radiographer posts. The Radiographers will operate Hand Held X-ray equipment.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification do I need?
faq.answer: You need a B.Sc in Radiography or a Diploma in Radiography.

faq.question: Q3. How much is the salary?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 680 a day, which comes to Rs. 17000 a month for 25 working days.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The Radiographers will be engaged on a daily-wage basis under NHM-TN.

faq.question: Q5. Where should I send my application?
faq.answer: Send it to the District Tuberculosis Officer, No.03 - Government District TB Centre, Government Medical College Hospital Campus, Ramanathapuram - 623 501.

faq.question: Q6. What is the deadline?
faq.answer: Your application must reach the District TB Centre office by 5.00 PM on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I attach?
faq.answer: Attach copies of your certificates and the relevant documents.

faq.question: Q8. Under whom will the Radiographers work?
faq.answer: They will work under the Joint Director - Health Services and the Joint Director - Medical Services (Tuberculosis).
